findings.skill_statement: The parenthetical dates the cited anchors to round 26, but those line ranges only became the anchors at the round-51 ten-leg re-anchor. At the round-26 content commit 40a12bf, tools/mutate-and-run.sh had its nine dispatches at :1384-1428 and the status aggregation at :1430-1459, while :1247-1248 was the sweep sub-invocation (`--workdir "$cwd" ...`) and :1459 was run_regression's closing `exit 0`; round 26's own SKILL.md:948 recorded the same sentence as `(:1384-1450 since round 26)`. Nor is the behaviour new at round 26: per-leg SETUP refusal and later-leg aggregation are already in the round-18 tool (58e5d53: refusal documented at :114 and :128, `local nlegs=8 ...` / `for st in ...` aggregation at :1355-1377). The anchors themselves do hold at C** (:1247-1317 refusal-before-suite, :1459-1508 ten dispatches, :1510-1517 aggregation); only the 'since round 26' date is stale.
